builds.name: Shrapnel Crit Build
builds.summary: Once Human's premier build for destroying the Great Ones and general PvE. Bullets fragment to tear through multiple body parts; can be specced for crit, weakspot hits, or a no-reload playstyle.

builds.name: Power Surge Build
builds.summary: Dump full magazines into enemies to trigger bursts of Electric damage. A well-optimized version can top out around 100,000 DPS without external buffs.

builds.name: Frost Vortex Build
builds.summary: Excellent against big boss enemies — the vortex feeds you health while draining theirs, making it a strong solo/duo boss-clearing build.

builds.name: Bounce Build
builds.summary: An underrated build where projectiles ricochet between enemies; damage gets absurd in tight corridors or dense groups of mobs.

builds.name: Fast Gunner LMG Build
builds.summary: Buffs a gun's damage and fire rate the longer you shoot. Best on high-magazine LMGs — a properly built MG4 Predator can unload roughly 200 rounds before needing to reload.

note: Builds combine a weapon effect archetype, weapon(s), mods and memetic specializations into a cohesive loadout. See the Builds & Classes section for archetype summaries and the Mods section for full mod effect details.
